Uses of Package
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model

Packages that use it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model
Package
Description
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.controller
Server-side controller (the "C" in MVC).
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui.managers
GUI support managers: encapsulate complex portions of the game board (player dashboard, card market, totem animations, and rendering) to lighten the FXML controllers.
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model
Game domain model (the "M" in MVC): rules, entities and game state.
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.buildings
Building Effects.
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.characters
Character Effects (Hunter, Constructor, Shaman and the passive ones: Artist/Inventor/Gatherer).
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.events
Global Event Effects (Hunting, Sustenance, Cave Paintings, Shamanic Ritual).
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.states
Concrete states of the game's state machine (State Pattern).
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.client
Client side of the network and local state.
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.messages
Network messages exchanged between client and server, with polymorphic dispatch.
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.rmi
RMI remote interfaces.
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.server
Server side of the network.

    Board
    Represents the physical layout of the game, managing the various card rows, the offering track, and the turn order tile.
    BuildingCard
    Building Card: unlike characters, it has a food cost (reduced by the player's discounts) and provides aura and/or effects that trigger in different phases (purchase, turn end, event, game end).
    Card
    Base class of all game cards (Characters, Events, Buildings).
    CharacterCard
    Character Card: belongs to one of the jobs (JobType) and, once picked, permanently enters the player's tribe, applying its immediate effect and notifying owned buildings.
    Deck
    Generic deck of cards (LIFO), based on a Stack.
    EventCard
